description.value:
You are not content to restrict yourself to one field. Instead, you've studied a wider range of necromantic magic to better expand your horizons and explore your unscrupulous fascinations. You learn the grave spell for a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Grim Fascination] other than yours. You must have access to that fascination. Access can be gained from independent study or sought-out tutelage.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different grave spell each time.
